rule.blocking: A decisive axis says no: {{axes}}. One is enough — you can’t sell nobody, and you can’t sell below your floor.
rule.decisiveUnmeasured: A decisive axis is not filled in: {{axes}}. Not knowing does not license a “go for it” — that is why the answer is “I’m missing data” and not “yes”.
rule.tooFewAxes: Fewer than three axes filled in. Below three axes there is no verdict.
rule.allClear: Both decisive axes are filled in and neither says no. Watch-outs are stated; they never overturn the verdict.
